'''Ishtah''' was a male [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked in [[Paolo's Chop Shop]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited this shop shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to sell his starfighter, ''[[Soulless One/Legends|Soulless One]]''. Ishtah's menacing stare reminded Obi-Wan of the vessel's previous owner, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The Kaleesh didn't trust the newcomer for some reason, but he nevertheless informed the owner of the shop, [[Zegundis]], of his arrival. Kenobi eventually managed to sell his starfighter after a heated bargaining with Zegundis, who was also wary of her client as she trusted Ishtah's judgement.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
